mapper.insert: SELECT SEQ_NOTE_FOLDER_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL INSERT INTO NOTE_FOLDERS(FOLDER_ID,PARENT_FOLDER_ID,OWNER_USER_ID,SCOPE_TYPE,WS_ID,PROJ_ID,FOLDER_NAME,SORT_ORDER,REG_DT) SELECT #{folderId},#{parentFolderId,jdbcType=NUMERIC},#{ownerUserId},#{scopeType},#{wsId,jdbcType=NUMERIC},#{projId,jdbcType=NUMERIC},#{folderName},NVL(#{sortOrder,jdbcType=NUMERIC},0),SYSDATE FROM DUAL WHERE ( #{scopeType} = 'PRIVATE' OR (#{scopeType} = 'WS' AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WORKSPACES w WHERE w.WS_ID=#{wsId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND w.OWNER_ID=#{ownerUserId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WS_MEMBERS wm WHERE wm.WS_ID=#{wsId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND wm.USER_ID=#{ownerUserId} AND UPPER(NVL(wm.WS_ROLE,'MEMBER'))='ADMIN') )) OR (#{scopeType} = 'PROJ' AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PROJECTS p WHERE p.PROJ_ID=#{projId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND p.LEADER_ID=#{ownerUserId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PROJ_MEMBERS pm WHERE pm.PROJ_ID=#{projId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND pm.USER_ID=#{ownerUserId} AND UPPER(NVL(pm.PROJ_ROLE,'MEMBER'))='ADMIN') )) )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NOTE_FOLDERS WHERE PARENT_FOLDER_ID=#{folderId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NOTES WHERE FOLDER_ID=#{folderId}

SELECT w.WS_ID AS "wsId", w.WS_NAME AS "wsName", w.WS_IMAGE_PATH AS "wsImagePath", CASE WHEN w.OWNER_ID=#{userId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WS_MEMBERS wa WHERE wa.WS_ID=w.WS_ID AND wa.USER_ID=#{userId} AND UPPER(NVL(wa.WS_ROLE,'MEMBER'))='ADMIN') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "canManage" FROM WORKSPACES w WHERE (w.OWNER_ID = #{userId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WS_MEMBERS wm WHERE wm.WS_ID=w.WS_ID AND wm.USER_ID=#{userId})) ORDER BY w.WS_NAME

SELECT p.PROJ_ID AS "projId", p.PROJ_NAME AS "projName", p.WS_ID AS "wsId", w.WS_NAME AS "wsName", CASE WHEN p.LEADER_ID=#{userId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PROJ_MEMBERS pa WHERE pa.PROJ_ID=p.PROJ_ID AND pa.USER_ID=#{userId} AND UPPER(NVL(pa.PROJ_ROLE,'MEMBER'))='ADMIN') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "canManage" FROM PROJECTS p JOIN WORKSPACES w ON w.WS_ID=p.WS_ID WHERE (p.LEADER_ID = #{userId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PROJ_MEMBERS pm WHERE pm.PROJ_ID=p.PROJ_ID AND pm.USER_ID=#{userId})) ORDER BY w.WS_NAME, p.PROJ_NAME

SELECT w.WS_ID AS "wsId", w.WS_NAME AS "wsName", u.USER_ID AS "userId", CASE WHEN NVL(mp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN NVL(mp.DISPLAY_NAME, u.USER_NAME) ELSE u.USER_NAME END AS "userName", NVL(mp.CONTACT_EMAIL, u.EMAIL) AS "email", wm.WS_ROLE AS "roleName", CASE WHEN NVL(mp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN mp.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH ELSE u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH END AS "profileImagePath" FROM WS_MEMBERS wm JOIN WORKSPACES w ON w.WS_ID = wm.WS_ID JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = wm.USER_ID LEFT JOIN WS_MEMBER_PROFILES mp ON mp.WS_ID = wm.WS_ID AND mp.USER_ID = wm.USER_ID WHERE (w.OWNER_ID = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM WS_MEMBERS me WHERE me.WS_ID = wm.WS_ID AND me.USER_ID = #{userId} )) AND wm.USER_ID != #{userId} ORDER BY w.WS_NAME, CASE WHEN wm.USER_ID = w.OWNER_ID THEN 1 WHEN UPPER(NVL(wm.WS_ROLE,'MEMBER')) = 'ADMIN' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, CASE WHEN NVL(mp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN NVL(mp.DISPLAY_NAME, u.USER_NAME) ELSE u.USER_NAME END

SELECT p.PROJ_ID AS "projId", p.PROJ_NAME AS "projName", w.WS_ID AS "wsId", w.WS_NAME AS "wsName", u.USER_ID AS "userId", CASE WHEN NVL(mp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN NVL(mp.DISPLAY_NAME, u.USER_NAME) ELSE u.USER_NAME END AS "userName", NVL(mp.CONTACT_EMAIL, u.EMAIL) AS "email", pm.PROJ_ROLE AS "roleName", CASE WHEN NVL(mp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN mp.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH ELSE u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH END AS "profileImagePath" FROM PROJ_MEMBERS pm JOIN PROJECTS p ON p.PROJ_ID = pm.PROJ_ID JOIN WORKSPACES w ON w.WS_ID = p.WS_ID JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = pm.USER_ID LEFT JOIN WS_MEMBER_PROFILES mp ON mp.WS_ID = p.WS_ID AND mp.USER_ID = pm.USER_ID WHERE (p.LEADER_ID = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PROJ_MEMBERS me WHERE me.PROJ_ID = pm.PROJ_ID AND me.USER_ID = #{userId} )) AND pm.USER_ID != #{userId} ORDER BY w.WS_NAME, p.PROJ_NAME, CASE WHEN pm.USER_ID = p.LEADER_ID THEN 1 WHEN UPPER(NVL(pm.PROJ_ROLE,'MEMBER')) = 'ADMIN' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, CASE WHEN NVL(mp.USE_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, 'Y') = 'N' THEN NVL(mp.DISPLAY_NAME, u.USER_NAME) ELSE u.USER_NAME END
